Title: The Handmaid's Tale
Description: In a dystopian near future, a totalitarian regime has taken power in what was once the United States. Offred is a Handmaid in the Republic of Gilead, where women are valued only for their ability to reproduce.

Title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
Description: The multi-generational story of the Buendía family, whose patriarch founded the town of Macondo. A landmark novel that tells the story of the rise and fall, birth and death of a mythical town.

Title: Beloved
Description: Set after the American Civil War, this is a story about the legacy of slavery and its dehumanizing effects on everyone touched by it. A haunting tale of love, loss, and redemption.

Title: Norwegian Wood
Description: A nostalgic story of loss and burgeoning sexuality set in Tokyo in the late 1960s. Toru Watanabe looks back on his days as a college student living in a Tokyo boarding house.

Title: Americanah
Description: A powerful, tender story of race and identity. As teenagers in Lagos, Ifemelu and Obinze fall in love. Their Nigeria is under military dictatorship, and people are fleeing the country if they can.
In a totalitarian future society, Winston Smith works at the Ministry of Truth as a history revisionist, but secretly hates the Party and dreams of rebellion against Big Brother.

Title: Mrs. Dalloway
Description: The novel follows a day in the life of Clarissa Dalloway in post-World War I England. It is one of Woolf's best-known novels, a modernist classic.

Title: The Alchemist
Description: The story of Santiago, an Andalusian shepherd boy who yearns to travel in search of a worldly treasure. A philosophical book about following your dreams and listening to your heart.

Title: White Teeth
Description: An ambitious, energetic novel about friendship, families, and the long reach of history. Set in northwest London, it follows the Joneses and the Iqbals through three generations.

Title: Midnight's Children
Description: The story of Saleem Sinai, born at the exact moment of India's independence, whose life becomes mysteriously connected to the nation's destiny.

Title: The House of the Spirits
Description: The story of the del Valle and Trueba families spans four generations, ranging from the turn of the century to the modern day. A sweeping saga of love, power, and politics.

Title: Never Let Me Go
Description: Kathy, Tommy, and Ruth live in a seemingly idyllic English countryside boarding school. But there is something eerily off about their upbringing and their ultimate fate.

Title: Atlas Shrugged
Description: Set in a dystopian United States, the novel depicts a society where government regulations have crippled productive achievement and where despair and rebellion have become the norm.

Title: Things Fall Apart
Description: The story of Okonkwo, an Igbo man living in the fictional Nigerian village of Umuofia. The novel depicts the impact of European colonialism on traditional Igbo society.

Title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings
Description: The first in a seven-volume series of autobiographies, it tells of Maya's life from age 3 to 17 and how strength of character and a love of literature can help overcome racism and trauma.

Title: The Testaments
Description: Set 15 years after the events of The Handmaid's Tale, this sequel is narrated by three female characters and reveals the inner workings of Gilead.

Title: Love in the Time of Cholera
Description: Set in a Caribbean seaport, it tells the story of an unrequited love that persists for more than fifty years. A tale of love, aging, and the passage of time.

Title: Kafka on the Shore
Description: A metaphysical reality where cats and people carry on conversations, a ghostlike pimp employs a Hegel-quoting prostitute, and a forest harbors soldiers apparently unaged since WWII.

Title: Animal Farm
Description: A satirical allegorical novella reflecting events leading up to the Russian Revolution of 1917 and then on into the Stalinist era of the Soviet Union.

Title: Half of a Yellow Sun
Description: Set during the Nigerian Civil War, the novel weaves together the lives of several characters, exploring themes of war, love, and the struggle for survival.
